dialogues.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
dialogues.text: Hey there! Great hero and magnificent leader, I await your command! How may I be of service?

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: I'm just a humble wrestler from the Collective of Plenty. I doubt you'd remember me, even if I introduced myself properly...

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: Which is why I've decided to style myself as "Utterly and Indisputably Vanquished Foe of the Mighty Varesa." At the very least, it should help me stand out from the crowd!

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: When Varesa was still only a few years old, she gave me an absolute pummeling. She picked me up one-handed and carried me out of the ring. How about that for a story, huh... Surely that's memorable enough?

choices.text: I command you to earn 10,000,000 Mora!

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: Wow, you must really believe in me! I'm not sure the whole park brings in that much money, let alone this one attraction...

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: I've been helping Varesa make deliveries for a good few years now, and I've never seen a transaction even close to that big!

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: As a boss, you must make a decent amount from dividends, right?

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: How about... you buy a 10-year membership at Coach Iansan's gym? Then buy the full set of ultimate courses. Trust me, that's a guaranteed winner right there!

choices.text: Just focus on doing a good job.

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: Understood! I won't let you down!
